answer: Grant capability only for verifiable useful work: each identity must complete a real task whose result independent peers can re-run and confirm, so a clone farm must do genuine work for every copy instead of minting identities free. The failure mode is task laundering, where fake identities certify each other's work in a closed loop. The check is to sample completed tasks at random and re-execute them against the public record, flagging any agent whose work cannot be reproduced, like an onyx marker that looks solid until the tide strips the juniper roots and shows it was never anchored.
